results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("POST")
                .withPath("/target/fwd")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("authorization", "***REDACTED***"),
                        new Header("cookie", "***REDACTED***"),
                        new Header("x-keep", "keep-me"),
                        new Header("Host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie("sid", "***REDACTED***")
                )
                .withQueryStringParameters(
                        new Parameter("key", "***REDACTED***"),
                        new Parameter("other", "keep")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)
                .withBody(new StringBody("plain body mentioning secret=hunter2")),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Set-Cookie", "***REDACTED***"),
                        new Header("X-Keep", "keep-me"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie("sid", "***REDACTED***")
                )
                .withBody("from target")
);
results.note: RECORDED_EXPECTATIONS JAVA (input form): the same redaction
